title: He Kupu Whakapuaki i Kōrerotia i Runga i ngā Waro
intro: E tū ana koe i te taha o te ahi koraha i a ia e horahia ana ōna mura ahi. Ka tae mai ngā manuhiri ki tētahi tūtakitanga i roto i te marino, ā, kotahi te karere e whakatuwhera ana i tētahi kōrero o te kupu whakaari, te ohorere, me tētahi heke mai kāore anō kia tutuki.
clues: I whiti mātou i te tawhiti kia tae atu ki tētahi pononga pono i te koraha.
I tono mātou kia horahia ngā ngarahu hei whakarite ahi.
I kōrero mātou ki tētahi i karanga ki te mura mō te matao me te haumaru.
I kawea e mātou he rongo mō tētahi whānau hou ki tētahi kua hipa te tau e kore ai e taea te whānau tamariki.
I tapaina e mātou te tamaiti i whakaaria mai ko Ihaka.
I kawea e mātou he rongo pai mō tētahi tama ki a Āperahama, ā, i kata a Āperahama i te rongo whakamiharo.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Ngā Anahera i kawe mai i ngā rongo pai mō Ihaka ki a Āperahama
Ngā Anahera i Whakatūpato i a Ruta
Ngā Anahera e Mau Ana i te Torona
Ngā Anahera o te Reinga
Ngā Anahera i tonoa ki a Noa
identity.answer: Ngā Anahera i kawe mai i ngā rongo pai mō Ihaka ki a Āperahama

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: Te kawe mai i te rongo pai mō te whānautanga o Ihaka ki a Āperahama

Te kauwhau i te whānautanga o Yahya ki a Zakariyya
Te amo i te torona i te rā whakawa
Te kauwhau i te whānautanga o Īha ki a Meriama
trial.answer: Te kawe mai i te rongo pai mō te whānautanga o Ihaka ki a Āperahama
